cluster_name.description: Optional cluster name filter; use an empty string to query all clusters.

index_pattern.description: Index or data stream pattern to investigate (e.g. logs-app.payments-*, .ds-metrics-k8s-*). Required.

lookback.description: Lookback window as ES|QL time span text (e.g. 15 minutes, 1 hour, 24 hours).

configuration.query:
FROM .monitoring-es-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= NOW() - TO_TIMEDURATION(?lookback)
| WHERE metricset.name == "shard"
| WHERE elasticsearch.index.name LIKE ?index_pattern
| WHERE (?cluster_name == "" OR elasticsearch.cluster.name == ?cluster_name)
| STATS latest_ts = MAX(@timestamp)
    BY elasticsearch.index.name,
       elasticsearch.shard.number,
       elasticsearch.shard.primary,
       elasticsearch.node.name,
       elasticsearch.shard.state
| EVAL is_primary     = CASE(elasticsearch.shard.primary == true, 1, 0)
| EVAL is_replica     = CASE(elasticsearch.shard.primary == false, 1, 0)
| EVAL is_not_started = CASE(elasticsearch.shard.state != "STARTED", 1, 0)
| STATS
    shard_slots = COUNT(*),
    primaries   = SUM(is_primary),
    replicas    = SUM(is_replica),
    not_started = SUM(is_not_started)
  BY elasticsearch.node.name
| SORT primaries DESC

description: Shows how primary and replica shards are distributed across nodes for the target index pattern. A node with disproportionately more primaries absorbs all write traffic — this is the monitoring-available root cause for indexing latency imbalance between indices. Also surfaces any non-STARTED shards (UNASSIGNED, INITIALIZING, RELOCATING) per node.
